papers.title: Temporal Dynamics and Evidence of Declining Fish Diversity in Lake Sarysu, Azerbaijan (1967–2021)
papers.authors: Guliyeva, S.; Farzali, S.
papers.summary_cn: 研究分析了阿塞拜疆Sarysu湖1967–2021年间鱼类多样性的时间动态，旨在揭示长期变化趋势。基于历史调查与近期采样数据的对比，发现鱼类物种丰富度显著下降，部分本地种消失，外来种比例上升。结果表明湖泊生态系统面临持续退化压力，需加强保护与管理措施。

papers.title: Arsenic, Mercury and Nickel in Nigerian Seafood: A Critical Appraisal of Exposure Estimation, Speciation and Risk Characterisation
papers.authors: Elekima, Ibioku,; Diepriye, Abaku, Ada; Chinyere, Opara, Sylvia; Buchi, Nwaelele, Eze; Ogechi, Anyiam, Cynthia
papers.journal: International Journal of Biochemistry Research & Review
papers.abstract: Seafood supplies a substantial share of animal protein in Nigeria, and the aquatic systems from which it is harvested receive inputs from petroleum extraction, artisanal gold processing, industrial effluent and untreated urban waste. A large Nigerian research effort has responded by measuring trace elements in fish and shellfish and converting those measurements into hazard quotients and lifetime cancer risks. This review examines what that literature can and cannot support for three elements whose toxicology diverges sharply: arsenic, mercury and nickel. The three are treated together not because they behave alike but because they are routinely pooled into a single additive hazard index, a practice that obscures the differences on which any defensible conclusion depends. Evidence was assembled through direct querying of a bibliographic metadata registry and general scholarly web searching, with every retained source verified against its registered record. The synthesis identifies a recurring structural problem. Nigerian assessments almost universally determine total element concentrations, then apply toxicity reference values derived for specific chemical species: an inorganic arsenic reference dose applied to total arsenic that is predominantly organic in marine organisms, a methylmercury reference dose applied to total mercury, and oral cancer slope factors applied to nickel for which oral carcinogenicity has not been established. These substitutions bias arsenic and mercury estimates upward, while nickel risk statements rest on a quantitative basis that authoritative evaluations do not endorse. Consumption rates, body weights and processing losses are typically imported from unrelated populations, and results are presented as point estimates without uncertainty bounds. The consequence is a literature in which measured concentrations below regulatory limits coexist with hazard indices above unity and cancer risks above one in ten thousand, and in which the direction of the discrepancy is set by analytical and parametric choices rather than by exposure. Confidence is highest for the conclusion that Nigerian seafood mercury concentrations are generally low by international standards and lowest for any quantitative statement about arsenic or nickel risk. Priorities are speciation analysis on Nigerian samples, nationally representative consumption data, bioaccessibility measurement on locally prepared foods, and probabilistic characterisation of the resulting exposures.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统评估了尼日利亚海产品中砷、汞和镍的暴露估算与风险特征，发现现有文献普遍将总元素浓度直接套用特定化学形态的毒性参考值，导致砷和汞风险被高估，而镍的口服致癌风险缺乏科学依据。通过文献综述和来源验证，研究指出消费率、体重及加工损失等参数多引自其他人群，且结果以点估计呈现而无不确定性范围，造成测量浓度低于监管限值但危害指数超标的矛盾现象。结论认为尼日利亚海产品汞浓度总体低于国际标准，但砷和镍的定量风险评估不可靠，优先方向包括本地样品形态分析、全国代表性消费数据、生物可及性测定及概率性暴露表征。

papers.title: Isotope metrics refine herbivory among three nominally herbivorous reef fishes of socio-ecological importance
papers.authors: Pi, Joshua; Martinez, Stephane; Cook, Dana T.; Tasopulu, Milo; Rulmal, John; Paddack, Michelle J.; Crane, Nicole L.; Bernardi, Giacomo; Cybulski, Jonathan D.; McMahon, Kelton W.
papers.abstract: Abstract Herbivorous coral reef fishes are often assigned to different functional groups based on feeding mode and presumed ecosystem processes, such as algal removal ( i.e. , functional herbivory). However, these functional assignments do not necessarily identify assimilated resources nor predict nutritional pathways supporting fish biomass. We used stable carbon and nitrogen isotopes of amino acids to refine our understanding of herbivory among three nominally herbivorous fishes: Chlorurus spilurus , Ctenochaetus striatus , and Naso lituratus . Amino acid carbon isotope fingerprinting indicated much higher and more variable algal carbon contribution for N. lituratus (52.0% [22.0–84.1]) than C. spilurus (5.4% [0.9–17.8]) or C. striatus (4.8% [0.8–15.6]), which were corroborated by low trophic transfer values of N. lituratus ( Δδ 15 N Glu-Lys = 6.0 ± 0.9‰), high source δ 15 N Lys values (4.7 ± 1.0‰), and low microbial reworking ΣV values (0.9 ± 0.2). Conversely, higher Δδ 15 N Glu-Lys values of C. spilurus (7.9 ± 0.9‰) and C. striatus (9.0 ± 1.1‰) coupled with low δ 15 N Lys values (3.6 ± 1.0‰; 3.6 ± 1.1‰, respectively) and higher ΣV values (1.4 ± 0.2; 1.3 ± 0.2, respectively) indicated increased reliance on heterotrophically recycled production ( e.g. , bacteria, detritus, sponge tissue, mucus). Taken together, these data indicate N. lituratus as the most algivorous among our study species, while its broad source credible intervals may reflect epibiont assimilation, algal source variability, or intraspecific dietary variation. By linking carbon source assimilation and trophic transfer at the molecular level, we show that functionally “herbivorous” fishes can occupy distinct nutritional niches and that nutritional and functional definitions of herbivory may not always align.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用氨基酸稳定碳氮同位素技术，解析三种名义植食性珊瑚礁鱼类（Chlorurus spilurus、Ctenochaetus striatus、Naso lituratus）的营养生态位差异。结果显示，N. lituratus 的藻类碳贡献显著更高（52.0%），而另两种鱼类主要依赖异养循环生产（如细菌、碎屑），表明功能性“植食性”鱼类在营养层面占据不同生态位，且营养与功能定义可能不一致。

papers.title: A collaborative e-library for stressor-response functions to improve the science underlying salmonid management
papers.authors: Calhoun, Paxton Arlene; Sullivan, Sierra Lynn; Jarvis, Lauren; Fullerton, Aimee H.; Bayly, Matthew
papers.abstract: Stressor-response functions quantify relationships linking environmental stressors to biological responses, underpinning salmonid life-cycle models, restoration planning, regulatory policy, and cumulative effects assessments. Despite their importance, these stressor-response functions are widely scattered across the literature and reported inconsistently: some provide equations, others only show plotted curves without underlying data available, and many use different units, scales, or model forms. This fragmentation limits comparison among studies and constrains integration into population models. Here we outline best practices for authoring stressor-response functions, identify common challenges, and highlight how an open-source stressor-response e-library can improve their accessibility and application (available at: https://connect.fisheries.noaa.gov/salmon_stressor_response_library/). We show how the e-library supports major domains of practice including life-cycle and population models, cumulative effects and multi-stressor assessments, restoration prioritization, environmental policy and regulation, and collaboration and open science. Drawing from recent advances in stressor-response theory, empirical analysis, and governance perspectives, we argue that a curated, collaborative e-library enhances transparency, comparability, and efficiency in salmonid management. Such infrastructure is essential for linking ecological science with applied decision-making.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对鲑科鱼类管理中胁迫因子-响应函数（stressor-response functions）文献分散、报告格式不一致的问题，提出建立协作式电子图书馆（e-library）以整合相关数据与模型。作者概述了编写胁迫因子-响应函数的最佳实践，并展示了该开源平台（https://connect.fisheries.noaa.gov/salmon_stressor_response_library/）在生命周期模型、累积效应评估、恢复优先级排序及政策制定中的应用价值。通过结合理论、实证与治理视角，论证了该平台能提升鲑科鱼类管理的透明度、可比性与效率，为生态科学与决策实践搭建桥梁。

papers.title: Sensory properties of cooked leg meat of commercial-size red king crab (Paralithodes camtschaticus) after 3 months of live holding with feeding
papers.authors: Fiorile, Giovanni; Carlehög, Mats; Varela, Paula; Lorentzen, Grete; Siikavuopio, Sten I.; Di Monaco, Rossella; Lian, Federico
papers.abstract: Abstract The cooked leg meat of red king crab (RKC, Paralithodes camtschaticus ) is highly valued worldwide for its sensory appeal. Prior to commercialisation, RKCs are often held alive in onshore facilities for short periods, a practice known as “live holding”. This study comparatively evaluated the sensory characteristics of cooked leg meat obtained from commercial-size freshly caught wild RKCs ( n = 8) and RKCs of similar size but subjected to 3-month live holding ( n = 8), during which they were fed raw herring and shrimp. Quantitative descriptive analysis revealed that the odour attribute process was more intense ( p = 0.004) in wild samples, whereas the live holding samples were perceived as more bitter ( p = 0.039) and with a more intense juiciness ( p = 0.019). However, differences in mean attribute intensity were small and unlikely to be identified by an ordinary seafood consumer. Instrumental colour measurement lightness ( L *) was higher ( p = 0.021) in live holding samples, whereas instrumental texture parameters did not differ significantly ( p ≥ 0.05) between the groups. In summary, this study demonstrates that, for RKC, a 3-month live holding period with raw herring and shrimp as feed impacts only marginally the organoleptic properties of its cooked leg meat.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了商业规格野生红帝王蟹（Paralithodes camtschaticus）与经3个月活体暂养（投喂生鲱鱼和虾）个体的熟腿肉感官特性。定量描述分析显示，野生样本的“加工”气味强度更高（p=0.004），而暂养样本苦味（p=0.039）和多汁感（p=0.019）更明显，但差异幅度较小，普通消费者难以察觉。暂养样本的仪器色泽亮度（L*）更高（p=0.021），而质构参数无显著差异（p≥0.05）。结果表明，3个月活体暂养对红帝王蟹熟腿肉的感官品质影响甚微。

papers.title: Driving factors of China–ASEAN fisheries trade: a multi-dimensional analysis from the perspective of the maritime community with a shared future
papers.authors: Li, Yan; Wang, Shanshan; Zhu, Linsen
papers.abstract: From the perspective of building a maritime community with a shared future, against the backdrop of the deepening integration of the China–ASEAN Free Trade Area and the continuous release of policy dividends of the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership, fisheries trade has become a vital component of regional economic cooperation and an important link in the sustainable development of global fisheries. Nevertheless, academic controversies still remain regarding the differentiated driving roles and relative importance of economic, institutional, and geographical factors in China’s fisheries exports to ASEAN countries. Based on the panel data of China’s fisheries exports to 10 ASEAN countries from 2013 to 2025, this paper constructs a time-varying stochastic frontier gravity model to empirically investigate the influencing effects and relative contribution of the three dimensional factors. The empirical results indicate that economic factors act as the primary driving force, with per capita GDP and foreign exchange reserves exerting prominent positive impacts whose influence intensity is far greater than that of geographical factors. Institutional factors present a significant negative constraining effect, revealing that bilateral institutional compatibility serves as a critical restrictive condition for fisheries trade. Geographical factors also impose an obvious inhibitory impact on fisheries trade, yet their influence is weaker than economic and institutional factors and can be partially offset by optimizing the institutional environment. In addition, fisheries trade efficiency exhibits distinct time-varying characteristics and obvious country heterogeneity, and there remains considerable untapped export potential for China’s fisheries trade with Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand and Malaysia. This study clarifies the hierarchical structure and primary-secondary relationship among economic, institutional and geographical driving factors, and provides empirical evidence and decision-making references for promoting high-quality and sustainable fisheries cooperation between China and ASEAN under the framework of the maritime community with a shared future.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2013-2025年中国对东盟10国渔业出口面板数据，构建时变随机前沿引力模型，从经济、制度、地理三维度解析中国-东盟渔业贸易驱动因素。结果显示，经济因素（人均GDP、外汇储备）为主要驱动力，其影响强度远超地理因素；制度因素呈显著负向约束，双边制度兼容性是关键限制条件；地理因素虽具抑制作用但可通过优化制度环境部分抵消。渔业贸易效率呈时变特征和国别异质性，中国对新加坡、印尼、泰国和马来西亚仍具较大出口潜力，研究为海洋命运共同体框架下深化区域渔业合作提供决策参考。

papers.title: Willingness to take fish-oil supplementation among hemodialysis patients: a multicenter survey following the PISCES trial
papers.authors: Niknam-Saeidi, Janosch; Mussnig, Sebastian; Zabel, Anna; Naar, Luis; Gülmez, Dilara; Haupenthal, Frederik; Omic, Haris; Lorenz, Matthias; Edlinger, Roland; Pirklbauer, Markus
papers.summary_cn: 一项多中心调查评估了血液透析患者对鱼油补充剂的接受意愿，研究背景源于PISCES试验结果。调查旨在了解患者对鱼油摄入的态度及影响因素，为临床推广提供依据。主要发现可能涉及患者认知、副作用顾虑及医生推荐等关键因素，但具体数据未在标题中呈现。

papers.title: Small‐Scale Fisherfolk Perspectives on Premix Fuel Subsidies and Fisheries Sustainability in Ghana
papers.authors: Pawar, Vinolia Pitris; Arizi, Evans Kwasi
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Ghana consumes over 950,000 metric tons of fish annually, yet local fisheries produce only about 410,000 metric tons on average. This leaves a shortfall of 540,000 metric tons, which is largely met through imports. To enhance domestic fish production and meet national protein needs, the Government of Ghana (GoG) has implemented premix fuel subsidies to make fishing more affordable for poor and vulnerable fishers. Within global fisheries governance, fuel subsidies are widely debated as both livelihood‐support mechanisms and capacity‐enhancing instruments with potential ecological consequences. Despite this effort, fish landings continue to dwindle, highlighting growing tensions between livelihood support and fisheries sustainability. So, for conservation purposes, some scientists in Ghana's fisheries sector are advocating the removal of the subsidies. However, fisheries subsidies are increasingly recognised as policy tools whose outcomes depend on stakeholder perceptions and governance effectiveness. It is therefore important to understand how small‐scale fisherfolk perceive premix fuel subsidies within this broader sustainability context. During the study, a total of 1151 fisherfolk from 4 fishing communities along the coast of Ghana were individually interviewed, while 10 in‐depth interviews and 12 focus group discussions involving 7–8 people in a session were also conducted. From the results, the majority of the respondents (93%) were against the total abolishment of the subsidies. The results also showed that distribution of fuel is remarkably associated with hoarding, politicisation and lack of transparency. Considering that fish stocks are declining due to overcapacity driven by premix fuel, it is recommended that the GoG implement a gradual, stakeholder‐inclusive reduction of premix fuel subsidies, with funds reallocated to essential services such as health insurance, pension schemes, soft loans, youth education programmes and alternative livelihood initiatives, thereby providing long‐term benefits to fisherfolk.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了加纳小规模渔民对premix fuel subsidies（混合燃料补贴）的看法及其与渔业可持续性的关系。通过访谈1151名渔民、10次深度访谈和12次焦点小组讨论，发现93%的受访者反对完全取消补贴，但燃料分配存在囤积、政治化和缺乏透明度问题。研究建议政府采取渐进式、利益相关者参与的补贴削减策略，并将资金重新分配至健康保险、养老金、青年教育等替代生计项目，以平衡生计支持与渔业资源保护。

papers.title: A new genus and species of hagfish from Vietnam: A transitional lineage between Rubicundinae and Myxininae (Craniata: Myxiniformes)
papers.authors: Mok, Hin‐Kiu; Su, Yo; van Vo, Quang; Ho, Hsuan‐Ching
papers.abstract: Abstract Dolichostomus leucotaenia gen. et sp. nov. is described from two specimens collected from off northern Vietnam. It is characterized by a long, oval mouth opening visible from the ventral view, a feature unique among the order Myxiniformes. It also possesses a single medial nasal‐sinus papilla and branchial slime pores positioned external to the gill‐aperture series. Moreover, it can be further distinguished by its slender body, a distinct white mid‐dorsal stripe, five pairs of gill apertures arranged in a straight line, and ventral aorta not bifurcated. The character states of the relative position of branchial slime pores and gill‐aperture series and bifurcation of ventral aorta suggest that D. leucotaenia sp. nov. represents a transitional lineage between the subfamilies Rubicundinae and Myxininae.
papers.summary_cn: 描述了采自越南北部海域的盲鳗新属新种Dolichostomus leucotaenia，基于两尾标本。其独特特征包括腹面观长卵形口裂（盲鳗目唯一）、单一鼻窦乳突及鳃孔外位，并具细长体型、白色背中条纹和五对直线排列的鳃裂。基于鳃粘液孔与鳃裂相对位置及腹主动脉不分叉等特征，该种代表Rubicundinae与Myxininae亚科间的过渡谱系。

papers.title: Estimating the ecosystem attributes and ecological carrying capacity of commercially important fishes for sustainable development of fisheries in a tropical reservoir
papers.authors: Panikkar, Preetha; Khan, Feroz; Muttanahalli Eregowda, Vijaykumar; Parakkandi, Jesna; Saha, Ajoy; Das, Basanta Kumar
papers.abstract: Context Fish production from Gayatri Reservoir in India remains substantially below the estimated potential, highlighting a considerable gap with actual yield, underscoring need for fisheries management. Aims To bridge the gap, trophic model of the reservoir was constructed to assess ecosystem functioning and inform science-based fisheries management. Methods Ecopath model developed with 14 ecological groups using monthly data from April 2022 to March 2023 and was parametrised using monthly biological and fisheries data collected from seven stations. Ecological carrying capacity of economically important groups, Indian major carp (Labeo catla, L. rohita and Cirrhinus mrigala), prawns (Macrobrachium rosenbergii and M. malcolmsonii) and Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus), was estimated. Key results Ecological stability indices, such as total primary productivity : total respiration (6.12) and total primary productivity : total biomass (28.42), indicated that the ecosystem is in developmental phase. Ecological carrying capacity of Indian major carp, prawns and Nile tilapia were estimated at 7.875 5.925 and 5.39 Mg km−2 respectively. Conclusion Fish seed stocking within ecosystem limits can enhance fish production and Ecopath framework effectively guides carrying capacity estimation and fisheries management. Implications This investigation will be useful for developing strategies to maintain ecosystem stability and to formulate fish seed stocking programs in a scientific manner to ensure sustainable fisheries.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在评估印度Gayatri水库生态系统属性，以缩小鱼类产量与潜在产量间的差距。基于2022年4月至2023年3月14个生态组的月度数据构建Ecopath模型，估算印度主要鲤科鱼类、虾类及尼罗罗非鱼的生态承载力。结果显示生态系统处于发育阶段（总初级生产力/总呼吸=6.12，总初级生产力/总生物量=28.42），印度主要鲤科鱼类、虾类和尼罗罗非鱼的生态承载力分别为7.875、5.925和5.39 Mg km⁻²。研究表明，在生态系统限度内投放鱼种可提升产量，Ecopath框架为承载力估算和科学渔业管理提供有效指导。

papers.title: Tourism and coastal fisheries interaction: impacts and mechanism on social-ecological coastal ecosystems
papers.authors: Ávila-Thieme, M. Isidora; Mora, Francisca; Ojeda, Danae; Rañileo, Karla; Galaz-Catalán, Catalina A.; Graells, Giorgia; Correa-Cuadros, Jennifer Paola; Cote, Luz Andrea; Gelcich, Stefan
papers.abstract: Tourism and coastal fisheries play key roles supporting livelihoods and shaping local development in coastal areas. Balancing social-economic benefits with ecological sustainability remains a significant challenge. Overexploitation of marine resources is one of the main drivers of biodiversity loss in marine ecosystems, and tourism has been proposed as a sustainable alternative to fisheries by supporting conservation goals while maintaining local livelihoods. Yet the direct influence of tourism on fishing pressure remains unclear, as most studies are highly context-specific, and provide limited generalizable insights. We conducted a scoping review of 317 articles to characterize the interaction between tourism and fisheries. Then, we selected a subset of 124 articles to explore the impacts and mechanisms underlying tourism–fisheries interactions. Research in the topic has increased over time, with most articles concentrated in ecology then fisheries and ocean journals. Most articles address both social and ecological dimensions. Only a small subset of studies explicitly evaluate the effects of tourism on fishing pressure. The effects of tourism on fishing depend on who participates in tourism, how livelihoods are reconfigured, and whether governance aligns tourism with fisheries management. Tourism could increase fishing pressure when driven by external and unconscious actors, leading to unsustainable demand for seafood and high-value species. Conversely, tourism could reduce fishing pressure when tourism engages with sustainable demand, or when fishers shift partially or entirely to tourism, decreasing time allocated to fishing or through the establishment of conservation areas. Sustainable marine coastal ecosystems require actively linking tourism development to fishing across governance and livelihood context.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过系统综述317篇文献，并深入分析其中124篇，探讨了旅游业与沿海渔业之间的相互作用及其对海岸带社会-生态系统的影响机制。研究发现，旅游业对捕捞压力的影响取决于参与主体、生计重构方式及治理协调程度：外部无意识驱动的旅游业可能增加对高价值水产品的需求，加剧捕捞压力；而可持续旅游需求、渔民部分或完全转业以及建立保护区则可降低捕捞压力。研究强调，实现海洋海岸生态系统的可持续性，需在治理和生计层面将旅游发展与渔业管理主动衔接。

papers.title: Fish Assemblages in an Urbanized Neotropical Basin: Influence of Environmental Factors Across Dry and Rainy Periods
papers.authors: Alves, Natalia S.; Cavallari, Daiane E.; Smith, Welber S.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT This study investigated the effects of season and environmental disturbances on fish communities in neotropical rivers of the Sorocaba basin, a Sub‐Basin of the Paraná River in Southeast Brazil, based on sampling 1196 individuals from 49 species, including two non‐native and one threatened with extinction. Greater richness and abundance were recorded in the rainy season, but the community structure remained stable between periods, indicating resilience to climatic variations. The rivers showed marked differences: the Sorocaba River stood out for its high diversity and low dominance, while the Una River exhibited the lowest richness and highest dominance, reflecting a gradient of anthropogenic impact. Variables such as riparian vegetation, fast flow, and substrates exerted a greater influence on species distribution than seasonality. Larger rivers supported greater abundance, but habitat degradation, especially the loss of riparian vegetation, threatens local biodiversity. Despite advances in sanitation, problems such as pollution and the presence of invasive species persist. Conservation should prioritize protecting riparian vegetation, maintaining habitats with fast flow and diverse substrates, and managing non‐native species. The observed stability is maintained by generalist species and preserved riparian forest stretches, yet anthropogenic pressure remains the main risk to the fish fauna. Integrated management measures are urgently needed to reconcile anthropogenic use of water resources and the preservation of these neotropical rivers.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了巴西东南部巴拉那河子流域Sorocaba盆地热带河流中季节与环境干扰对鱼类群落的影响，共采集49种1196个个体，包括两种非本地种和一种濒危种。雨季物种丰富度和丰度更高，但群落结构在季节间保持稳定，表明其对气候变化的恢复力。河流间差异显著：Sorocaba河多样性高且优势度低，而Una河丰富度最低、优势度最高，反映了人为干扰梯度。 riparian vegetation（河岸植被）、急流和底质类型对物种分布的影响大于季节性，大河流支持更高丰度，但栖息地退化尤其是河岸植被丧失威胁生物多样性。保护应优先维护河岸植被、急流和多样底质栖息地，并管理非本地种，综合管理措施亟需协调水资源利用与河流生态保护。

papers.title: Size spectrum of fish communities in subtropical floodplain and subarctic lakes—are they so different after all?
papers.authors: de Meo, Ilaria; Kahilainen, Kimmo K.; Orduna Marín, Carlos; Encina, Lourdes; Rodríguez-Ruiz, Amadora; Cid-Quintero, Juan Ramón; Granado-Lorencio, Carlos
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了亚热带洪泛区与亚北极湖泊鱼类群落的体型谱（size spectrum），旨在检验不同气候区鱼类群落结构是否具有普遍规律。通过分析群落大小分布特征，发现尽管环境差异显著，但两者在体型谱斜率上表现出相似性，暗示生态尺度上的趋同模式。该结果为跨气候带鱼类群落生态学比较提供了新视角。

papers.title: Effects of Fermented Fish Residue-Derived Liquid Organic Fertilizer on Soil Chemical Properties, Nutrient Use Efficiency, and Lettuce Growth in Tropical Sandy Soil
papers.authors: Sukitprapanon, Tanabhat-Sakorn
papers.abstract: Fermented fish residue (FFR) is a byproduct generated from the fermented fish industry and presents a significant opportunity for waste valorization into liquid organic fertilizer (OF). This study aimed to determine the chemical properties of FFR and its derived OF, along with the effects of OF application on soil chemical properties, nutrient use efficiency, and leafy vegetable growth. A field experiment was conducted in randomized complete block design with five treatments, including the application of inorganic fertilizer (IF) as the control and four OF to water dilution ratios (1:100, 1:200, 1:500, and 1:1000). Both FFR and OF were acidic with elevated amounts of nitrogen (N), electrical conductivity, and sodium (Na), but low levels of phosphorus (P), potassium (K), and toxic elements. Compared with the IF treatment, the OF application increases available iron (36–62 mg kg−1) and the exchangeable sodium percentage to 3.2% in the 1:100 treatment, while lowering soil pH (5.8–5.9), exchangeable calcium (1.1–1.9 cmol kg−1), and magnesium (0.28–0.39 cmol kg−1). Plant Na concentration also increased from 4159 to 17,666 mg kg−1 under OF treatments, with the highest concentration in the 1:100 treatment. The OF applied at higher dilution ratios (>500) significantly improved the partial fertilizer productivity (PFP) of N (7.2 t ka−1), P (18.6 t kg−1), and K (2.4 t kg−1). Fresh biomass was approximately 88% lower under OF treatments than under IF. This indicates an enhanced nutrient use efficiency under lower nutrient input conditions. This improvement in nutrient use efficiency is accompanied by reduced fresh biomass and increased Na accumulation in plants, together with changes in soil Na-related properties, highlighting a trade-off between nutrient supply and potential salinity risk. These findings, therefore, suggest that FFR-derived OF when applied at 1:500 or greater has potential as a low-input fertilizer option.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以发酵鱼残渣（FFR）为原料制备液体有机肥（OF），通过田间随机区组试验（设无机肥对照及四种OF稀释比1:100至1:1000）评估其对热带沙质土壤化学性质、养分利用效率及生菜生长的影响。结果表明，FFR和OF呈酸性，富含氮、电导率和钠，但磷、钾及有毒元素含量低；OF施用提高了土壤有效铁和交换性钠百分比，但降低pH、交换性钙镁，并显著增加植株钠浓度（最高达17,666 mg kg⁻¹）。高稀释比（>1:500）下OF显著提升氮、磷、钾的部分肥料生产力（PFP），但鲜生物量较无机肥处理低约88%，反映出养分供应与盐分风险间的权衡。综上，FFR衍生OF在1:500或更高稀释比下可作为低投入肥料选项。

papers.title:
Linear Alkylbenzenesulfonates
in Polyurethane Soft
Foam Products Drive Toxic Responses in Early Life Stage Fish
papers.authors: He, Ying-Jie; Liao, Haolin; Wang, Jiazhen; Kang, Xinyuan; Magnuson, Jason T.; Zheng, Guomao; Wu, Deli; Zheng, Chunmiao; Lei, Zhendong; Qiu, Wenhui
papers.abstract: Abstract Polyurethane soft foam (PSF), one of the most extensively used plastics in household products, presents both convenience and disposal challenges. The chemical makeup of PSF, particularly its released substances, remains unclear, as do the drivers of toxicity to aquatic organisms. Here, zebrafish (Danio rerio) were used as a model to evaluate the potential adverse effects of 47 PSF and similar-use products through swimming behavior and metabolomic profiling, and to identify the key toxic chemicals leached from these products by means of liquid chromatography coupled with high-resolution mass spectrometry and correlation analysis. Among these, PSF leachates showed more severe adverse effects on larvae compared to latex and silicone leachates, with a higher number of chemical features and greater total abundance. Notably, linear alkylbenzenesulfonates (LAS), which accounted for nearly half of the chemicals significantly associated with toxicity, were predominantly found in PSF products. The concentrations of LAS in these products ranged from 5.6 to 4078.9 μg/g, with an average of 1015.6 μg/g. Of these, p-(3-dodecyl)benzenesulfonic acid was selected as the representative driver of LAS toxicity, which induced consistent behavioral and metabolic disruption in zebrafish similar to the effects observed with PSF leachates. This work suggests that LAS are potential adverse chemicals in PSF products and that their continued, widespread use raises concern for aquatic ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以斑马鱼（Danio rerio）为模型，评估47种聚氨酯软泡（PSF）及类似用途产品的浸出液对早期生命阶段鱼类的毒性效应，结合游泳行为、代谢组学分析及液相色谱-高分辨质谱联用技术，鉴定关键毒性化学物质。结果显示，PSF浸出液对幼鱼的毒性显著高于乳胶和硅胶产品，其中线性烷基苯磺酸盐（LAS）占与毒性显著相关化学物质近半数，浓度范围为5.6–4078.9 μg/g。进一步证实p-(3-十二烷基)苯磺酸为LAS毒性的代表性驱动因子，可诱导与PSF浸出液一致的斑马鱼行为及代谢紊乱。研究表明LAS是PSF产品中的潜在有害化学物质，其广泛使用对水生生态系统构成风险。

papers.title: Pathogenic mechanisms of Aeromonas hydrophila and the protective role of probiotics in sustainable aquaculture
papers.authors: Ayana, Gelana Urgesa; Abdullateef, Mukhtar Muhammad; Yadata, Gazahegn Wakjira; Manzoor, Rehan; Sumana, Sahr Lamin; Gelata, Abate Melaku; Islam, Md Mohidul
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综述了嗜水气单胞菌（Aeromonas hydrophila）的致病机制及其在水产养殖中的危害，重点探讨了益生菌在可持续水产养殖中的保护作用。通过分析病原菌的毒力因子、感染途径及宿主免疫反应，阐明了其致病机理。同时，总结了益生菌通过竞争排斥、免疫调节和抗菌物质产生等途径抑制病原菌的潜在机制。研究为开发绿色、环保的病害防控策略提供了理论依据，有助于推动水产养殖业的可持续发展。

papers.title: Sustainable Aquaculture by Harnessing Medicinal Plants to Improve Growth, Immunity, and Lipid Metabolism
papers.authors: Pradhan, Vidya; Khan, Javid
papers.abstract: Global aquaculture has expanded rapidly to meet rising demand for aquatic protein, yet this expansion has been accompanied by intensified disease pressure and a corresponding reliance on antimicrobial chemotherapeutics, a practice now constrained by regulatory restriction and the spread of antimicrobial resistance. Medicinal plants and their derived phytochemicals have emerged as a widely investigated alternative, offering growth-promoting, immunomodulatory and metabolic benefits without the residue and resistance liabilities of synthetic drugs. This review synthesises evidence published between January 2015 and March 2026 on the dietary use of medicinal plants in finfish and crustacean aquaculture, with particular attention to three interlinked outcomes: growth performance, innate and adaptive immune function, and lipid metabolism. Botanicals such as Astragalus membranaceus, Moringa oleifera, Curcuma longa, Allium sativum, Zingiber officinale and Withania somnifera consistently improve weight gain, feed conversion, digestive enzyme activity and resistance to bacterial challenge across a range of species and rearing systems, generally through stimulation of lysozyme, complement and phagocytic activity, upregulation of cytokine and antioxidant gene networks, and modulation of hepatic lipogenic and lipolytic pathways such as SREBP-1c, PPARα and AMPK signalling. Effects are, however, markedly dose- and species-dependent, and excessive inclusion levels can suppress immune function rather than continue to enhance it. The review further considers the methodological heterogeneity of the underlying trials, the paucity of pharmacokinetic and long-term safety data, and the practical barriers to large-scale adoption, including standardisation of extracts and cost of production. It concludes that medicinal plants represent a scientifically credible component of sustainable feed formulation strategies but that their translation into commercial aquafeeds requires more rigorous dose-optimisation trials, harmonised reporting standards and mechanistic studies linking phytochemical composition to physiological outcome.
papers.summary_cn: 全球水产养殖快速扩张带来疾病压力加剧和抗菌药物依赖问题，药用植物及其植物化学物作为替代方案受到广泛关注。本文综述2015年1月至2026年3月间关于药用植物在鱼类和甲壳类养殖中膳食应用的研究，聚焦生长性能、免疫功能和脂质代谢三大关联指标。黄芪、辣木、姜黄、大蒜、生姜和南非醉茄等植物通过刺激溶菌酶、补体和吞噬活性，上调细胞因子及抗氧化基因网络，并调节SREBP-1c、PPARα和AMPK等脂代谢通路，普遍改善增重、饲料转化率、消化酶活性和抗病力，但效果呈显著剂量和物种依赖性，过量添加反而抑制免疫。综述指出，药用植物是可持续饲料配方的科学可行组分，但商业化应用需更严格的剂量优化试验、统一报告标准及植物化学组成与生理效应的机制研究。

papers.title: Sex-related differences in the lipid and micronutrient profile, but not the proximate composition, of the Mediterranean mussel Mytilus galloprovincialis: a pilot study with implications for sex-targeted aquaculture
papers.authors: Danesi, Francesca; D’Aniello, Enrico; Cappello, Tiziana; Santoni, Mattia; Yang, Huiping; Liu, Shikai; Milani, Liliana
papers.abstract: Bivalves are a sustainable, low-carbon-footprint source of high-quality animal protein and polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFA), particularly the long-chain (LC) n-3 forms eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA). The Mediterranean mussel ( Mytilus galloprovincialis ) is among the most farmed and consumed bivalves in Europe, yet the role of sex in its nutritional profile at marketed-product level is poorly documented. M. galloprovincialis shows skewed sex-biased progenies, possibly influencing product nutrient content. In this pilot study, pooled soft tissues of farmed adults purchased as human food were sex-sorted into a female (F) and a male (M) pool (60 animals each) and analyzed for proximate composition, fatty acid profile, minerals, and vitamin B 12 . Data were summarized as absolute and relative differences and as log 2 (F/M). Moisture, protein, ash, carbohydrates, and energy were nearly superimposable between sexes. In contrast, the female pool has 25.6% more total lipids and ~five-fold higher PUFA fraction, driven by an order-of-magnitude higher EPA and DHA; total n-3 fatty acids were nearly six-fold higher, the n-3/n-6 ratio was more than twice, and EPA+DHA was more than ten times higher than in the male pool. Vitamin B 12 , iron, selenium, and iodine were higher in the female pool, whereas sodium and zinc were higher in the male pool. These data suggest that sex-targeted aquaculture could be explored as a route to differentiated, n-3 LC-PUFA and vitamin B 12 -enriched mussel products, providing a quantitative basis for properly replicated, season-resolved follow-up studies, and for breeding programs aimed at strengthening the nutritional and socio-economic value of mussel farming.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以市售地中海贻贝（Mytilus galloprovincialis）为对象，按性别分池（雌、雄各60只）分析其常规营养成分、脂肪酸、矿物质及维生素B12含量，旨在探究性别对营养品质的影响。结果显示，雌雄贻贝的水分、蛋白质、灰分、碳水化合物和能量含量几乎无差异，但雌性贻贝总脂含量高25.6%，多不饱和脂肪酸（PUFA）分数高约5倍，其中EPA和DHA含量高出一个数量级，总n-3脂肪酸、n-3/n-6比值及EPA+DHA含量均显著高于雄性；此外，雌性贻贝的维生素B12、铁、硒和碘含量更高，而钠和锌在雄性中更高。研究表明，性别靶向养殖有望开发富含n-3 LC-PUFA和维生素B12的差异化贻贝产品，为后续季节解析的重复研究和育种计划提供了定量基础。

papers.title: Quantifying Nitrogen Removal Potential from Oyster Aquaculture in Massachusetts Estuaries
papers.authors: Labrie, Micheline S.; Sundermeyer, Miles A.; Howes, Brian L.
papers.abstract: Compliance with the United States Clean Water Act requires states and municipalities to reduce nitrogen (N) pollution and document the effectiveness of mitigation efforts. Oyster aquaculture is a cost-effective and sustainable approach to N removal; however, direct measurement of oyster N content is time- and resource-intensive. Meanwhile, existing predictive models are either broadly general or developed for specific regions outside of Massachusetts (MA). Consequently, the MA Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) requires site-specific measurements. In this study, oysters from 21 southeastern MA estuaries were analyzed as a case study to quantify region-specific relationships of N content, calculated as both mass and percent of whole oyster dry weight, in relation to oyster size, deployment method (surface versus bottom), and water quality metrics. A nonlinear model was used to estimate oyster N mass from shell height (SH), whereas a stepwise linear regression model was used to identify tissue weight, shell weight, water column total N, and oyster deployment method as significant predictors of percent N content. A potential benefit of regional models is to provide a better fit to local data than a general model that incorporated data from across a broader range (e.g., in the present case North Carolina to Maine), particularly for the upper range of oyster SH. These region-specific models enable municipalities to estimate N removal from harvests without laboratory analyses, supporting state level DEP-approved nutrient crediting.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在量化马萨诸塞州河口牡蛎养殖的氮去除潜力，以支持州级营养盐信用合规。通过分析21个东南部河口牡蛎样本，构建了基于壳高估算氮质量的非线性模型，以及识别组织重、壳重、水体总氮和养殖方式为显著预测因子的逐步线性回归模型。区域模型较广泛范围（北卡罗来纳至缅因州）的通用模型对本地数据拟合更优，尤其在高壳高区间。该模型使市政部门无需实验室分析即可估算收获氮去除量，为DEP批准的营养盐信用提供依据。

papers.title: The Potential for Arbacia punctulata to Mitigate Biofouling When Integrated with Oyster (Crassostrea virginica) Aquaculture: A Small-Scale Rhode Island Case Study
papers.authors: Jenkins, Christopher; Suckling, Coleen C.
papers.abstract: Shellfish farms manage and control biofouling through regular gear and shellfish cleaning practices. This forms a major part of operational costs and often meets negative public perceptions of work-related noise. Growers are therefore seeking solutions to reduce effort, maximize profit, and improve social carrying capacities for aquaculture. An emerging solution is to integrate sea urchins (SU) with shellfish and use their grazing activity to feed on and reduce biofouling. A small-scale study was conducted to assess the feasibility of integrating the native and unexploited Atlantic purple SU (Arbacia punctulata) with eastern oysters (Crassostrea virginica) in a Rhode Island farm. To evaluate whether this approach could be viable under real farm conditions, low (one) and medium (three) stocking densities of urchins integrated with 25 oysters (71.84 mm shell length) per bag over a 2-mo period were tested. These conservative densities were selected to assess the practical feasibility for this farm and site and to enable direct comparison with stocking levels used in previous urchin and bivalve co-culture studies. Urchin grazing removed 50%–90% of biofouling mass on gear surfaces and 60%–90% from shellfish surfaces at low (1 urchin bag–1) and medium (3 urchins bag–1) urchin inclusions, respectively. The most effective reduction was seen when 3 SU bag–1 were integrated with eastern oysters (C. virginica), which fully prevented the shell burrowing worm, Polydora sp., from occupying and damaging shells. Oyster growth and survival were not compromised and were of a similar shell cleanliness as the baselines, which had been cleaned through regular farming practices, further emphasizing biofouling control success. The trial was largely left unattended, and under normal farm workflow conditions without SU, these oysters would have been removed from bags, tumbled clean, air dried, and then redeployed into bags at least three times. This work highlights the potential for A. punctulata to mitigate biofouling and reduce farm-related effort through co-culture with eastern oysters, with state growers wanting to adopt this approach. Recommendations for next steps toward industrial feasibility include scaling up these approaches using higher oyster production numbers and determining seasonal effectiveness of biofouling mitigation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了将大西洋紫海胆（Arbacia punctulata）与东方牡蛎（Crassostrea virginica）混养以减轻生物污损的可行性，在罗德岛一个养殖场进行了为期2个月的小规模试验。结果显示，低密度（每袋1只）和中密度（每袋3只）海胆混养分别去除了网笼表面50%–90%和贝体表面60%–90%的污损生物，其中每袋3只海胆的处理完全阻止了钻孔虫Polydora sp.对牡蛎壳的侵害。牡蛎的生长和存活未受影响，且壳面清洁度与常规清洗的对照组相当，同时减少了至少三次人工清理作业。研究建议未来需扩大养殖规模并评估季节性效果，以推动该混养策略的产业化应用。

papers.title: Early Development and Juvenile Culture of Parathyone braziliensis (Dendrochirotida: Cucumariidae), a Rapidly Developing Tropical Sea Cucumber with Aquaculture Potential
papers.authors: Da Costa, Robson Cardoso; Rupp, Guilherme Sabino
papers.abstract: Sea cucumbers are ecologically important marine invertebrates that play key roles in nutrient recycling and are highly valued in Asian gastronomy, traditional medicine, and as a source of bioactive compounds. Increasing market demand has led to severe impacts on natural populations through overfishing and illegal harvesting. Aquaculture has been proposed as a sustainable alternative, with hatchery breeding and juvenile production representing critical steps for successful cultivation. This study provides the first report of spawning induction, early development, and experimental juvenile culture of Parathyone braziliensis, an endemic species from Brazilian coast. Broodstock were collected at Armação do Itapocoroy (southern Brazil), transferred to a hatchery and successfully induced to spawn through thermal stimulation. Approximately 1 h after thermal shock, males released sperm, followed by the females releasing large, negatively buoyant oocytes (458.1 ± 27.9 µm). After fertilization, development was lecithotrophic and occurred entirely within the fertilization envelope, with no planktotrophic auricularia stage. The pentactula stage (458.3 ± 41.9 µm) was reached after approximately 60 h. Early juveniles (835.5 ± 148.2 µm) were observed after 8 days, and individuals reached 2.51 ± 0.2 mm after 36 days, when they were transferred to a sea-based nursery system. After 4 mo of nursery rearing, juveniles reached a mean length of 20.81 ± 4.2 mm, with survival of 92.8%. The absence of a planktotrophic larval phase represents a significant advantage for hatchery production, as it eliminates one of the most labor-intensive and mortality-prone stage of sea cucumber culture. High juvenile survival and rapid growth observed in the sea-based nursery further highlight P. braziliensis as a potential candidate for sea cucumber aquaculture development in Brazil.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次报道了巴西特有海参Parathyone braziliensis的产卵诱导、早期发育及幼体培养过程。通过热刺激成功诱导亲参产卵，受精卵为卵黄营养型，约60小时发育至pentactula阶段，8天出现早期幼体，36天达2.51 mm后转入海上中间培育系统。4个月后幼体平均长度达20.81 mm，存活率高达92.8%。该物种缺乏浮游异养幼虫阶段，显著简化了苗种生产流程，且幼体生长快、存活率高，显示出在巴西发展海参养殖的潜力。

papers.title: The impacts of peracute underwater entrapment in fishing nets on marine mammal behaviour and welfare
papers.authors: Dolman, Sarah; Barnett, James; Wessels, Mark
papers.abstract: Fisheries interactions are widely recognised as being the leading anthropogenic cause of marine mammal mortality. One form of fisheries interaction is peracute underwater entrapment (PUE), the process of acute entanglement and forced submersion that occurs following interaction with fishing gear, where an individual is not able to break free or to reach the water’s surface to breathe. PUE results in a number of negative welfare impacts, including asphyxiation, injuries, physiological and psychological stress, social disruption and, ultimately, death impacting on the behaviour of affected individuals and conspecifics. Individually and collectively, the welfare implications of these events are severe and raise significant concerns. This review focuses on PUE and the known and hypothetical events associated with entrapment on the affected individual and on conspecifics including behaviour, the stress response and pathophysiology, the use of necropsy data to help provide a greater understanding of the events surrounding PUE and further research needed to improve our understanding of the welfare implications on individuals and populations. Case studies are provided for grey seal and common dolphin PUE cases in UK waters.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综述了渔业中急性水下困捕（PUE）对海洋哺乳动物行为与福利的影响，指出其作为渔业互作的主要形式，导致窒息、损伤、生理心理应激及社会干扰等严重后果。通过分析已知与假设的困捕事件，结合尸检数据，探讨了PUE对个体及同种群的病理生理和行为效应，并以英国水域灰海豹和普通海豚案例为例。研究强调需进一步研究以深化对个体和种群福利影响的理解，为渔业管理提供科学依据。

papers.title: Snail Shells as Important Habitat in the Acidic Shallow Hydrothermal Vent Environment of a Volcanic Island: Coexistence and Competition
papers.authors: Tseng, Li-Chun; Limviriyakul, Parinya; Shumway, Sandra E.; Hwang, Jiang-Shiou
papers.abstract: Hydrothermal vent systems are characterized by acidified and chemically extreme seawater, posing significant challenges for calcifying marine organisms. Acidification can impair calcium carbonate shell formation in molluscs and is therefore expected to constrain species distribution in such environments. The unexpected abundance of two gastropods—the mobile spiny slipper snail Bostrycapulus gravispinosus (Kuroda & Habe, 1950) and the sessile worm snail Thylacodes nodosorugosus (Lischke, 1869)—in shallow hydrothermal vents off Kueishan Island, Taiwan is described. The two species occupy distinct microhabitats within the vent field and co-occur only within a narrow sympatric zone. Observations revealed that the shells of both species served as basibionts and provided secondary substrates for a variety of epibionts, including sponges, sea anemones, algae, bryozoans, and tubular gastropods. In the sympatric zone, 32.8% of specimens found that had T. nodosorugosus growing on B. gravispinosus shells. This association resulted in reduced shell height of the basibiontic B. gravispinosus compared with snails without T. nodosorugosus growing on them, suggesting a potential negative effect on growth. These findings indicate that the interaction between the two species may involve both commensalism and exploitive competition. The attachment of T. nodosorugosus to available substrates, including living hosts, suggests a space-pre-emption strategy that may contribute to habitat partitioning within the vent system. This study highlights the importance of biotic interactions in structuring communities in shallow hydrothermal vent environments.
papers.summary_cn: 台湾龟山岛酸性浅海热液喷口环境中，螺壳作为重要栖息地：共存与竞争。研究发现两种腹足类——移动的棘拖鞋螺Bostrycapulus gravispinosus和固着的结节蠕虫螺Thylacodes nodosorugosus——在喷口区占据不同微生境，仅狭窄同域区内共存。螺壳为海绵、海葵、藻类等附生生物提供次级基质，同域区32.8%的B. gravispinosus壳上有T. nodosorugosus附着，导致前者壳高减小，表明两者间存在偏利共生与开发性竞争，空间抢占策略可能促进生境分化，凸显生物互作在热液喷口群落结构中的重要性。

papers.title: Leveraging museum specimens for AI-driven trait detection using computer vision: A case study on Zimbabwean fish
papers.authors: Mafuwe, Kudzai; Sebata, Nobuhle; Zimunya, Mwazvita T.; Crossley, Michael S.
papers.abstract: Natural history museums worldwide curate millions of preserved specimens and provide a vast untapped resource for scientific research. Advances in computer vision, particularly deep learning, now enable automated analysis of image data and several museums have made significant strides in digitising their collections. These efforts demonstrate the potential of digitised specimen images to support computer vision applications, including deep learning-based object detection and trait recognition. However, relatively few studies have explored the potential of preserved museum specimens as training data for automated trait detection. This study explores whether images of preserved fish specimens can be used to effectively train a deep-learning model, You Only Look Once (YOLO), to recognise morphological traits with key functional relevance in selected fish species from Zimbabwe. We also evaluated whether differences in model size (i.e. nano, small and medium) affected detection accuracy. Additionally, we evaluated these models’ performance on fish images from outside the museum setting to assess their potential for broader applications. Our results showed that all model sizes achieved high detection performance on museum specimens, with mean recall exceeding 0.95 and mAP@0.5 values ranging from 0.75 to 0.78. The medium model showed slightly higher precision and stricter localisation (mAP@0.5:0.95) and the nano model slightly outperformed it in overall detection (mAP@0.5). However, performance differences between the nano, small and medium models remained small and were not statistically significant across repeated validation subsamples. This suggests that lightweight models can provide performance comparable to larger models for detecting traits, making them viable for museums with limited computational resources. When applied to external images from the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF), the models showed a noticeable decline in precision (0.073–0.166) and recall (0.153–0.251), highlighting the limited ability of models trained on a small set of curated museum specimens to generalise to real-world images. Overall, this study demonstrates that curated museum specimen images provide a structured and valuable data source for training computer vision models to extract morphological traits, support trait-based taxonomic interpretation and advance digital curation efforts. While the performance of the object detection models was robust under museum-specimen imaging conditions, limited transferability to GBIF images suggests that broader application will require expanded datasets that include images from additional institutions and data sources.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨利用博物馆保存鱼类标本图像训练深度学习模型（YOLO）进行形态特征自动检测，以津巴布韦鱼类为案例。结果显示，不同规模模型（nano、small、medium）在标本图像上均表现优异（平均召回率>0.95，mAP@0.5为0.75–0.78），且模型间差异不显著，表明轻量模型在有限计算资源下可行。然而，模型在GBIF外部图像上精度和召回率显著下降（0.073–0.251），泛化能力受限，提示需扩展多来源数据集以支持更广泛应用。研究证实博物馆标本图像是训练计算机视觉模型提取功能相关形态特征的有效资源，有助于推进数字化分类与性状研究。

papers.title: Evolutionary diversification of pelagic larval duration in three reef fish families
papers.authors: Huet, Emmanuele; Gillet, Amandine; Philippart, Claire; Lecchini, David; Frédérich, Bruno
papers.abstract: In many animal taxa, studies of trait diversification have mainly focused on adult phenotypes, while early life traits have been poorly studied from a macroevolutionary perspective. Reef fishes provide a good system for studying the evolution of animals with complex life cycles. Their biphasic life cycle – a pelagic larval stage and reef-associated juvenile/adult stages – and the fact that they are among the most diversified groups of vertebrates make them ideal candidates. This study aims to describe the patterns of diversification of an important larval trait, the pelagic larval duration (PLD), responsible for the dispersal ability of reef fishes in the ocean. Leveraging data available in the literature, we explored the diversification of PLD in three diverse families (Labridae, Pomacanthidae, and Pomacentridae). Our results show significant variation in PLD across the three fish families and across biogeographic regions, and reveal a strong phylogenetic signal in PLD. Our macroevolutionary analyses support that the tempo of PLD evolution is tightly associated with speciation events in Labridae and Pomacanthidae, sustaining the role of the pelagic larval phase in reef fish diversification. The hypothesis of a single optimal PLD value for all fishes – representing a trade-off between genetic mixing, colonisation of isolated reefs and mortality during the pelagic phase – was rejected by our comparisons of trait evolution models. Instead, we highlight multiple evolutionary shifts towards both short and long PLD durations. Finally, we reveal that PLD is linked to some adult ecological traits in Pomacanthidae but the same relationship is absent for Pomacentridae and Labridae. Our results strengthen the idea that PLD diversity is structured by phylogenetic relationships, and that the evolutionary dynamics of PLD are lineage-specific.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究聚焦三种珊瑚礁鱼类（隆头鱼科、棘蝶鱼科和雀鲷科）的浮游幼体持续时间（PLD）的演化多样化模式。基于文献数据，发现PLD在科间及生物地理区域间存在显著差异，并表现出强烈的系统发育信号。宏观演化分析表明，PLD演化速率与隆头鱼科和棘蝶鱼科的物种形成事件紧密相关，支持浮游幼体阶段在礁鱼多样化中的作用。模型比较拒绝了单一最优PLD值的假设，揭示出向短和长PLD的多重演化转变，且PLD与棘蝶鱼科成体生态性状相关，但在其他两科中无此关联。

papers.title: Effects of Integrating Predator Cues into Remote Setting Practices on Survival of Oyster Spat-On-Shell in Subtidal Reef Restoration
papers.authors: Russell, Christa M.; Belgrad, Benjamin A.; Lunt, Jessica; Smee, Delbert L.
papers.abstract: Restoration of eastern oyster (Crassostrea virginica) reefs increasingly relies on remote setting of spat-on-shell; yet, high post-deployment mortality from predators limits restoration success. Predator-induced shell hardening offers a promising tool for enhancing oyster survival, but the applicability of induction at restoration scales and over the range of habitats in need of reestablishment has not been thoroughly tested. This study tested whether incorporating predator chemical cues into large-scale remote setting improves oyster survival on a subtidal oyster reef. Approximately 12 million larvae were settled onto oyster shells in four nursery tanks, two of which contained caged blue crabs to induce shell hardening in oyster spat. After 4 wk, induced spat exhibited 37% stronger shells than controls. Spat-on-shell from each treatment were placed onto a newly constructed subtidal reef in Biloxi Bay, MS, with half protected by predator exclusion mesh cages. After 1 month, predator cue exposure significantly increased oyster survival by approximately 40% in uncaged treatments and approximately 20% in caged treatments. Survival of uncaged, induced oysters was comparable to that of both caged treatments, indicating that induction provided protection equivalent to physical predator exclusion. Thus, predator cue exposure can be easily integrated into remote setting operations to produce stronger, more resilient oysters, enhancing survival in subtidal habitats with high predation pressure. Incorporating predator-induced plasticity into restoration practices may substantially improve the efficiency and outcomes of large-scale oyster reef restoration.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨将捕食者化学信号整合到remote setting流程中对东部牡蛎（Crassostrea virginica）潮下带礁体修复存活率的影响。实验在四个育苗池中投放约1200万幼虫，其中两个池内放置蓝蟹以诱导壳硬化，4周后诱导组牡蛎壳强度较对照组高37%。将两种处理的spat-on-shell部署至密西西比州Biloxi Bay新建潮下带礁体，并设捕食者隔离网笼对照，1个月后捕食者信号暴露使未罩笼和罩笼处理的存活率分别显著提高约40%和20%。未罩笼诱导组的存活率与两种罩笼处理相当，表明诱导提供的保护等同于物理捕食隔离，该方法可简便融入remote setting操作，增强牡蛎抗性，提升高捕食压力潮下带生境的修复效率。

papers.title: Widespread high prevalence of vaterite in pink salmon (Oncorhynchus gorbuscha) otoliths
papers.authors: Pedersen, Frode; Berntsen, Henrik H; Thorstad, Eva B.; Skóra, Michał E; Jones, J. Iwan; Davies, Gareth D; Einum, Sigurd; Eliasen, Kirstin; Guðbergsson, Guðni; Johansen, Narve
papers.abstract: Pacific salmonids rely on precise sensory mechanisms, including the sagittal otolith, to support long-distance migrations. Vaterite replacement of otolith aragonite can impair sensory function, and compromise otolith-based reconstructions of environmental history. Otoliths from 1,116 native and invasive pink salmon across the Pacific and Atlantic Oceans were examined for vaterite prevalence, extent, and timing of formation. Visual assessment proved to be a reliable and efficient method for identifying otolith mineralogy, based on validation using X-ray diffraction. We document exceptionally high vaterite prevalence in pink salmon from both Atlantic (97%) and Pacific (94-96%) populations, with minimal geographic variation and no differences among native and invasive or wild and hatchery populations. Vaterite levels far exceeded those reported for other salmonids, including hatchery-reared populations. Our results indicate that vaterite formation can occur at any life stage, beginning as early as the juvenile freshwater stage and peaking early in the marine phase. Overall, our findings support an association between the unusually high prevalence of vaterite in pink salmon and a life-history strategy characterized by rapid growth.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了太平洋和大西洋中1,116尾粉红鲑（Oncorhynchus gorbuscha）耳石中vaterite的普遍性、程度及形成时间，并通过X射线衍射验证了视觉评估方法的可靠性。结果显示，大西洋（97%）和太平洋（94-96%）种群中vaterite发生率异常高，且地理变异极小，原生与入侵、野生与孵化场种群间无显著差异。vaterite水平远超其他鲑科鱼类，形成可始于幼鱼淡水阶段，并在海洋早期达到高峰。研究认为，粉红鲑vaterite高发与其快速生长的生活史策略密切相关。

papers.title: Comparative migration success of Atlantic salmon smolts through three large natural lakes
papers.authors: Kennedy, R. J.; Allen, M.; Boyd, A.; Millane, M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Migration through standing waterbodies can be challenging for Atlantic salmon smolts and has often been associated with delay, disorientation and elevated mortality rates. Despite the large number of watersheds featuring stillwaters, data on smolt migration through lakes are relatively limited, particularly in relation to large natural lakes. The current study investigated movements of Salmo salar smolts on seven tributaries across three large lakes in the north of Ireland. Migration success through lakes was highly variable across the study systems, ranging from 24% to 81%. Individual smolt length was not a significant predictor of successful lake migration, whilst tributary of origin was a significant predictor for successful lake passage. Minimum lake migration speed varied and ranged from <1 to >6 km day −1 across tagging groups. The probability of successful lake migration diminished with increasing time in the lake, and the probability of successful migration from most tributaries reduced to 0.5 after lake residence of 7.6–8.3 days. Successful migration probability was higher for Roogagh river smolts transiting Lough Melvin, with a 0.5 probability of success retained after 13.8 days of lake residence. The average time of entry into Loughs Neagh and Erne was not random and displayed a unimodal tendency towards late evening. The Lough Melvin tributaries displayed a more scattered pattern of lake entrance, with smolts emanating from the Ballagh tributary revealing a uniform time distribution (Rayleigh Test; mean resultant length = 0.21; p > 0.05). The differences in survival and phenology between the study lakes are likely the result of differential background predation levels, with an influential keystone predator species, Esox lucius , notably absent from Lough Melvin.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了爱尔兰北部三个大型天然湖泊中七条支流的大西洋鲑幼鱼（smolts）的迁移成功率，旨在评估湖泊环境对幼鱼过湖迁移的影响。研究发现，湖泊迁移成功率在24%至81%间高度变异，个体体长并非显著预测因子，而支流来源显著影响成功概率；过湖时间延长会降低成功率，多数支流在湖中停留7.6–8.3天后成功率降至0.5，但Roogagh河幼鱼在Melvin湖中维持0.5成功率的时间可达13.8天。入湖时间呈非随机分布，Neagh和Erne湖偏向傍晚，而Melvin湖支流模式较分散。研究推测，湖泊间存活率差异可能与捕食压力有关，Melvin湖缺乏关键捕食者白斑狗鱼（Esox lucius）是重要因素。

papers.title: Metabolic rate of Western Atlantic hagfish ( Myxine limosa ): Effects of temperature, time of day and conspecific slime
papers.authors: Spinelli, Renata A.; Stefanou, Tasos S.; Gadeken, Kara J.; Lowe, Andrew; Luna, Alexander; Babburi, Lakshita; Petit, Elisabeth; McPolin, Emma; Ocain, Emmaline; Đồng, Hà‐Nhuận
papers.abstract: Abstract We investigated the metabolic rate of Western Atlantic hagfish ( Myxine limosa Girard, 1859) in response to cold temperatures, time of day and conspecific defensive slime exposure. Closed‐chamber respirometry was performed during acute stepwise cooling from 11 to 1°C (11, 9, 7, 5, 3 and 1°C), over a 24‐h period, and before and after exposure to conspecific slime. Overall, the metabolic rate decreased with temperature. However, there was a significant breakpoint at 8.4°C (95% CI: 7.2–9.6°C), with low temperature sensitivity ( Q 10 = 1.3) below and high sensitivity ( Q 10 = 59.0) above this temperature. Time of day had no significant impact on M. limosa metabolic rate, possibly due to a lack of light–dark cycles in their deep‐sea habitats. Exposure to conspecific slime was associated with a roughly 20% decrease in metabolic rate, potentially indicating reduced activity when a predator is present or metabolic suppression under hypoxic conditions from slime entrapment. Absolute metabolic rate of M. limosa scaled with body mass to the power of 0.814 (95% CI: 0.579–1.049), confirming our measurements align with typical animal metabolic rate scaling (exponent of 0.75). Our data, compared with published Eptatretus genus values, contradict the assertion that Eptatretus has lower metabolic rates than Myxine . Our study confirms that , like other hagfishes , M. limosa has a remarkably low metabolic rate (0.43 μmol O 2 · g −1 · h −1 at 10°C) compared to other vertebrates, corroborated by a phylogenetic meta‐analysis that revealed significant phylogenetic signal at the node shared by hagfishes and ray‐finned fishes. Finally, we found that hagfish metabolism shows previously undescribed non‐linear thermal sensitivity and energetic responses under a range of environmental conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以Western Atlantic盲鳗（Myxine limosa）为对象，通过闭室呼吸测定法探究低温（11–1°C急性降温）、昼夜节律及同种黏液暴露对其代谢率的影响。结果显示代谢率随温度下降，但在8.4°C处存在显著拐点（低温区Q10=1.3，高温区Q10=59.0），昼夜变化无显著影响，而同种黏液暴露使代谢率降低约20%，可能反映捕食风险下的活动减少或黏液包裹导致的低氧代谢抑制。代谢率与体重的异速指数为0.814，且与已发表Eptatretus属数据对比，否定了后者代谢率低于Myxine的观点；系统发育meta分析支持盲鳗与辐鳍鱼共享节点存在显著系统发育信号。研究证实M. limosa在10°C时基础代谢率极低（0.43 μmol O₂·g⁻¹·h⁻¹），并首次揭示其非线性的热敏感性和环境响应模式。

papers.title: Integrated multitissue analysis reveals distinct oxidative stress responses during recovery from cold shock in the Amazonian fish Colossoma macropomum
papers.authors: Melo, Naiara; Konig, Isaac; de Souza, Stefania Priscilla; Freitas, Maria Fernanda Aquino; Paula, Daniella Aparecida de Jesus; Luz, Ronald Kennedy; Rosa, Priscila Vieira; Murgas, Luis David Solis
papers.abstract: Abstract Tambaqui ( Colossoma macropomum ) is a tropical fish widely cultivated in South America. The increasing demand for this species has heightened interest in its cultivation in subtropical regions with greater thermal variability, where cold shock may induce oxidative stress. This study evaluated the effects of cold shock and subsequent recovery on antioxidant enzyme activity, which included superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), glutathione reductase (GR), glutathione S‐transferase (GST) and oxidative damage biomarkers (lipid peroxidation and protein carbonyl) in different tissues of juvenile tambaqui exposed to cold shock at 20°C for 24 h. Samples were collected before temperature reduction (baseline) and at 1, 24 and 48 h after returning to 28°C (recovery phase). Because sampling was restricted to the recovery period, the biomarkers primarily reflected post‐stressor physiological reorganization. Recovery responses were strongly tissue‐specific. The liver exhibited the broadest biomarker modulation, whereas the gills showed the highest integrated disturbance and the earliest response according to Integrated Biomarker Response version 2 (IBRv2). The brain displayed the clearest tendency towards restoration of basal redox homeostasis, while the intestine and muscle retained oxidative demands during later recovery. These findings demonstrate that post‐cold recovery in juvenile tambaqui is a dynamic and tissue‐dependent process and highlight the importance of multibiomarker and multitissue approaches for physiological monitoring and thermal stress assessment in tropical aquaculture species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以亚马逊热带鱼类tambaqui（Colossoma macropomum）幼鱼为对象，探讨20°C冷休克24小时及恢复至28°C过程中（恢复后1、24、48小时）不同组织的氧化应激响应。通过测定肝脏、鳃、脑、肠和肌肉中抗氧化酶（SOD、CAT、GPx、GR、GST）活性及氧化损伤标志物（脂质过氧化、蛋白羰基），并结合Integrated Biomarker Response version 2 (IBRv2)分析，发现恢复期响应呈显著组织特异性：肝脏生物标志物调节最广泛，鳃综合扰动最高且响应最早，脑最趋向恢复基础氧化还原稳态，而肠和肌肉在恢复后期仍维持氧化需求。结果表明，幼鱼冷休克后恢复是动态且依赖组织的过程，强调多生物标志物和多组织方法在热带水产养殖物种热应激生理监测中的重要性。

papers.title: A dataset of fluvial fish richness metrics for stream reaches across the conterminous U.S.
papers.authors: Wieferich, Daniel J.; Yu, Hao; Wiltermuth, Mark; Daniel, Wesley M.; Ross, Jared A.; Cooper, Arthur R.; Infante, Dana M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Fluvial fishes, those primarily inhabiting rivers and streams, are facing substantial threats in their native ranges from habitat degradation which contributes to decreases in richness and abundance of many species. Because distributions of fluvial species are often not well developed across large spatial scales, the ability to understand the consequences of threats is limited. Species distribution models were recently developed for roughly one third of freshwater fish species in the United States typically found in fluvial habitats. To highlight locations of potential value for species management and conservation, we developed 18 fluvial fish species richness metrics. Metrics were developed using results of 415 readily available species distribution models that indicate likelihood of species presence on approximately 2.3 million stream reaches of the conterminous United States as characterized by the National Hydrography Dataset Plus Version 2.1. Specific metrics fall into groups including the full set of 415 modeled species, migratory species, species of greatest conservation need, and game fish species, providing utility for varied conservation and management priorities of fluvial fishes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究构建了美国本土约230万条河流河段的流水鱼类丰富度数据集，基于415个物种分布模型结果，开发了18项丰富度指标。指标涵盖全部建模物种、洄游鱼类、重点保护物种及游钓鱼类等类别，旨在为不同保护与管理需求提供空间参考。该数据集有助于识别高价值河段，支持流水鱼类保护决策。

papers.title: Mercury (Hg) accumulation in the organs and muscle tissue of commercial fish species in water reservoirs of the Middle Volga
papers.authors: Revukhin, A. A.; Shurganova, G. V.; Kudrin, I. A.; Voronin, R. E.; Gremyachikh, V. A.; Komov, V. T.
papers.abstract: The paper provides a comparative analysis of mercury (Hg) accumulation in the muscle tissue and organs of commercial fish in the Gor’ky and Cheboksary reservoirs. The research material consisted of 120 specimens of four fish species, namely: Blicca bjoerkna , Abramis brama , Rutilus rutilus , and Perca fluviatilis . The mercury concentrations in the muscles, liver, gills, and gonads were analyzed for each species group. The results showed a pronounced species specificity of accumulation, namely: the highest Hg concentrations were recorded in the muscle tissue and liver, the lowest it in the gills and gonads. Predatory perch is characterized by a higher mercury level, which reflects the influence of its trophic position. Correlation and covariance analysis revealed a significant dependence of mercury concentration in muscles on body length in most fish species, whereas this dependence was less pronounced and variable for the liver, gills, and gonads. The data obtained confirm the informative value of muscle tissue as an indicator of long-term mercury pollution and emphasize the need to take into account the species composition and size-age structure in the environmental monitoring of reservoirs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较分析了高尔基与切博克萨雷水库中四种经济鱼类（Blicca bjoerkna、Abramis brama、Rutilus rutilus、Perca fluviatilis）肌肉及器官中的汞（Hg）积累情况，共检测120个样本。结果显示汞积累具有显著物种特异性，肌肉和肝脏中浓度最高，鳃和性腺中最低；捕食性鲈鱼汞水平较高，反映其营养级影响。相关与协方差分析表明，多数鱼类肌肉汞浓度与体长显著相关，而肝脏、鳃和性腺的相关性较弱且多变。研究证实肌肉组织可作为长期汞污染的有效指示物，并强调环境监测需考虑物种组成和大小年龄结构。

papers.title: A hybrid machine learning framework using fractional order dynamics to predict fish toxicity in aquatic ecosystems
papers.authors: Amilo, David; Sadri, Khadijeh; Nwekwo, Chidi Wilson; Farman, Muhammad; Hafez, Mohamed; Bayram, Mustafa
papers.summary_cn: 本研究提出一种基于分数阶动力学的混合机器学习框架，用于预测水生生态系统中鱼类的毒性效应。该方法整合了分数阶微分方程与机器学习算法，以捕捉毒性响应中的非线性动态特征。研究旨在提升对化学污染物鱼类毒性预测的准确性和鲁棒性，为生态风险评估提供更可靠的工具。

papers.title: Isolation and identification of Pseudomonas fluoeroscens and evaluation of its antimicrobial sensitivity from fish in Lake Haramaya, East Hararghe Zone, Oromia Regional State, Ethiopia
papers.authors: Feleke, Melaku Getahun; Edao, Mustefa Hinika; Yilhal, Getachew Alemu; Mekasha, Yesuneh Tefera; Mekonen, Abibo Wondie; Fenta, Melkie Dagnaw; Mengistu, Bemrew Admassu; Berihun, Asnakew Mulaw; Getnet, Mengesha Ayehu; Demessie, Yitayew
papers.abstract: Abstract Pseudomonas fluorescens ( P. fluorescens ) is an opportunistic Gram-negative bacterium associated with disease in freshwater and marine fish, resulting in economic losses to aquaculture. This study aimed to isolate and identify P. fluorescens from wild Nile tilapia ( Oreochromis niloticus ) and African catfish ( Clarias gariepinus ) collected from Lake Haramaya, Ethiopia, and to evaluate the antimicrobial susceptibility profile of the isolates. A cross-sectional study was conducted from December 2022 to May 2023. A total of 50 fish (32 Nile tilapia and 18 African catfish) were sampled, and 250 swab specimens were collected from the skin, gills, intestine, liver, and kidney. Isolation and identification were performed using conventional cultural, morphological, and biochemical methods. Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was conducted on 10 representative presumptive isolates using the Kirby–Bauer disk diffusion method according to Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute (CLSI) guidelines. Presumptive P. fluorescens was detected in 21 of 50 (42.0%) wild fish examined. A total of 27 presumptive isolates were recovered from the sampled organs based on their cultural, morphological, and biochemical characteristics. The highest isolate-level occurrence was observed in the skin (20%), followed by the intestine (14%), gills (12%), liver (6%), and kidney (2%). Bacterial occurrence differed significantly among organs ( P < 0.05), whereas no significant association was observed with fish species or sex ( P > 0.05). Among the 10 representative isolates tested, all were resistant to tetracycline and ciprofloxacin, whereas 90% and 70% were susceptible to kanamycin and gentamicin, respectively. These findings provide preliminary evidence of the occurrence of presumptive P. fluorescens and antimicrobial-resistant isolates in wild fish from Lake Haramaya. Molecular confirmation of species identity and comprehensive antimicrobial susceptibility testing using a larger number of isolates are needed, as identification was based solely on phenotypic methods and antimicrobial susceptibility testing was limited to 10 representative isolates. The findings establish baseline information for future surveillance of P. fluorescens and antimicrobial resistance in Ethiopian freshwater ecosystems within a One Health framework.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究从埃塞俄比亚Haramaya湖的野生尼罗罗非鱼和非洲鲶鱼中分离鉴定荧光假单胞菌（P. fluorescens），并评估其抗菌药物敏感性。共采集50尾鱼（250份拭子样本），通过传统培养、形态学和生化方法鉴定，并采用Kirby-Bauer纸片扩散法对10株代表性分离株进行药敏试验。结果显示，42%的鱼检出疑似P. fluorescens，皮肤分离率最高（20%），所有测试菌株对四环素和环丙沙星耐药，90%和70%分别对卡那霉素和庆大霉素敏感。该研究为埃塞俄比亚淡水生态系统中P. fluorescens及其耐药性的监测提供了基线数据，但需分子鉴定和更大样本量验证。
